hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.php$'; then vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; echo 'formatted php'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then ruff format --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || strands_agents/.venv/bin/ruff format --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; echo 'formatted python'; fi
vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --error-format=raw 2>&1 | head -10; RUFF=$(command -v ruff || echo strands_agents/.venv/bin/ruff); $RUFF check strands_agents/ 2>&1 | head -10
